subject.title: feat: ask_user — structured questions from the agent with web card, channel buttons, and text answers

question: Should `operator.questions`, the five question RPCs, two broadcasts, and `plugin-sdk/question-gateway-runtime` become permanent public core/plugin contracts in this form?
rationale: The patch creates additive but durable Gateway and Plugin SDK surfaces whose ownership and compatibility obligations cannot be settled by tests or automated review alone.

options.title: Accept after repairs
options.body: Adopt the public question contract after fixing both blockers and refreshing cross-client compatibility proof.

options.title: Keep resolver internal
options.body: Expose the user-facing feature while retaining question resolution behind internal channel runtime helpers rather than a new public Plugin SDK subpath.

options.title: Phase the protocol
options.body: Land a narrower internal Gateway/runtime slice first and defer public SDK and native-client exposure until the contract is separately reviewed.

recommendation.title: Accept after repairs
recommendation.body: Adopt the public question contract after fixing both blockers and refreshing cross-client compatibility proof.

likelyOwner.reason: This person owns both the merged Codex question foundation and the proposed provider-neutral implementation across the affected surfaces.
